title: Carlyle’s Acosta Files Bankruptcy as Marketing Budgets Wane
主要内容: Acosta Inc., the marketing firm owned by Carlyle Group LP, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Wilmington, Delaware, after major consumer-product firms decided to handle more of the work internally to adapt to changing consumer preferences. Creditors including Elliott Management Corp., Oaktree Capital Management, Davidson Kempner Capital Management, and Nexus Capital Management agreed to a restructuring plan that would transfer ownership to creditors and reduce long-term debt by $3 billion.
